exam_format: Varies: online assessment (CSM) or training completion (CSPO, CSD, CAL)
exam_rules: Most certifications awarded upon completing certified training. CSM includes an 50-question online exam (74% pass). CSP-SM/CSP-PO require active lower-level certifications and experience.
id_requirements: Scrum Alliance account required. Training attendance verified.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: "This test consists of 50 multiple-choice questions; you must correctly answer 37 of the 50 questions to pass the test and receive your certification."

prerequisites.description: Attend a 2-day Certified ScrumMaster course from a Certified Scrum Trainer (CST)

renewal_options: All certifications expire every 2 years. Renew by earning 20 SEUs (Scrum Education Units) and paying renewal fee ($100).

retake_policy.notes: 60-day waiting period for CSM exam retake. Retake fee $25. Unlimited retakes.

testing_centers.notes: CSM and CSP-SM exams taken online through Scrum Alliance portal after completing training. Most certifications are training-based, not exam-based.
